reason: Conversation 2 clarified that 'SA2' is a model series and not an error code, asked sensible diagnostic questions about the fan and the other oven settings, and guided a safe power-off hand check of the blade. It correctly identified a seized fan motor and said the full model number from the rating plate is needed for parts, with an engineer as the fallback. Its flaw is over-escalating the single hot smell into a 'stop using entirely' warning, though that is cautious rather than harmful. Conversation 1 wrongly guessed a fan/rear ring element first, never asked for the rating plate model, gave a vague 'no match in our catalogue' dead end, and offered little guidance on safe checks or on whether a DIY swap is feasible.
